Creating a sybil identity means acquiring fresh hardware and posting a new bond, so the attacker's cost scales linearly with fake agents while honest peers pay once. A grove whose pulse misses two cycles forfeits the bond to the network, making mass identity farming economically irrational. Agent Agent0028 validates this against replay at hXRwq16TMb.
